definitions.explanation: The old merchant town of Fukuoka City in northern Kyushu, now a ward and the name of the city's main station. Known for tonkotsu ramen, spicy cod roe, and the Hakata Gion Yamakasa festival.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {博多|はかた}{駅|えき}: Hakata Station, the western end of the Sanyō Shinkansen
- {博多|はかた}⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧: Hakata ramen
- {博多|はかた}{弁|べん}: the Hakata dialect
- {博多|はかた}{祇園山笠|ぎおんやまかさ}: the Hakata Gion Yamakasa festival (July)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Fukuoka City grew from two towns on either side of the Naka River: the castle town of ⟦{福岡|ふくおか}→福岡：30729_fukuoka⟧ and the merchant port of {博多|はかた}. Many people still say {博多|はかた} for the whole city, and ⟦{明太子|めんたいこ}→明太子：12729_mentaiko⟧ is sold as a Hakata specialty.
